events.text: Quinn: Oh, Pia — the repair drive is this Saturday, and everyone’s welcome. If you want, I can save you a spot and send the details over.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Pia: That would help — can you send me the time and where to drop things off? I just want to make sure I’ve got the logistics right.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it starts at 10 a.m. at the community center, and you can drop items off at the side entrance.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but we should pin down the timing and what supplies are needed first.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm what time works best and what supplies we still need?
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Pia: I can do late morning, if that works, and I’d like to know exactly what tools and replacement parts we’re still missing.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Pia: Yes, please send me the exact time and drop-off location, and let me know which tools and replacement parts are still needed.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rey: I can bring screws and duct tape today, and I’ll look for a couple of strong flashlights too. Send me the exact drop-off spot and time, and I’ll keep it simple.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: Thanks — I’ll send the exact drop-off spot and time once I have it. For now, screws, duct tape, and flashlights sound like a good start.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: I’ll write down the remaining fixes, and we can go through them one by one. Then we’ll know exactly what needs doing.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Pia: That works for me — late morning is best, and I still need the exact list of tools and replacement parts before I can help much. Let’s pin down the supplies first, then we can go through the fixes one by one.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Eli: Good idea — I’ll make a clean list of the tools and parts first, then we can match them to each fix one by one.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Sam: Sounds good — just come by when you’re ready and knock. I’ll be around with the hammer and screwdrivers.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Sam: Sure thing — just knock when you get here, and I’ll hand over the hammer and screwdrivers.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Pia: Late morning still works for me, but I need the exact list of tools and replacement parts before I can commit to anything else.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Mara: That makes sense, Pia — I’ll get you the exact list of tools and replacement parts, and check who’s available too.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Pia: Late morning still works for me, but I need the exact list of tools and replacement parts before I can commit to anything else.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll get the exact tools and replacement parts list for you and pass the repair drive details along too.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that would help a lot. Once I have the exact list and details, I can see what I can manage.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Pia: Late morning still works for me, but I need the exact tools and replacement parts list before I can commit to anything else. Once we have that, we can sort the fixes one by one.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send the updated repair drive details and the tools and parts list now. If anything’s unclear, just let me know.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — please send it over, and I’ll check the list as soon as I can. If anything’s missing, I’ll let you know right away.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Pia: Hi Pia — what’s the latest on the repair drive, and do you need anything from me?
